contexts.text: In this way they were led to reflect on the heavenly marriage, from which they perceived the happiness of their marriages to come...
It is the heavenly marriage which is regarded here in the inmosts. The heavenly marriage is such that it is in the proprium...
It is the heavenly marriage which is signified here too.
The heavenly marriage is such that Heaven, thus the Church, is united to the Lord through proprium, insomuch that it is in the proprium...
For it is the heavenly marriage which is the veriest covenant. The heavenly marriage or conjunction does not come forth except with those who are being regenerated.
These perpetual marriages derive their beginning... from the heavenly marriage...

The heavenly marriage with the man of the Most Ancient Church was in his voluntary proprium; but the heavenly marriage with the man of the Ancient Church was effected in his intellectual proprium. Explained.

The heavenly marriage itself is solely between Divine good and Divine truth... Without conception from the heavenly marriage man can never be imbued with understanding, reason, or knowledge... In proportion therefore that he draws from the heavenly marriage is he a man. In the Lord Himself there is the heavenly marriage, so that the Lord is that marriage itself... Angels and men are in the heavenly marriage in proportion as they are in love to the Lord and charity towards the neighbour, and in the derivative faith...
Divine good and Divine truth are united with each other as in a marriage; for thence is the heavenly marriage... AC 2618. AC 2649. AC 2739. AC 2803.
The Divine marriage, from which descends the heavenly marriage, which is the Lord's Kingdom itself in the Heavens.

The heavenly marriage of good and truth in each thing of the Word. AC 2909. AC 3614:5. AC 4105:end. AC 4112:end. AC 4137:3. AC 4137:4. AC 4691. AC 6343:2. AC 6343:end. AC 8339:end. AC 8875:3. AC 9385:end. AC 9391:5. AE 288:3. AE 778:5. AE 798. AE 938. AE 1142.
When the one is of the other, then there is the heavenly marriage. AC 2839.

The conjunction of Divine good and Divine truth in the Lord is the Divine marriage itself, from which is the heavenly marriage, which in like manner is the marriage of good and truth; and from it is conjugial love... Hence it is that where in the Word it treats of marriage, in the internal sense the heavenly marriage is signified, which is that of good and truth. AC 3956:3.
Thus man enters into the heavenly marriage; for the heavenly marriage is the conjunction of good and truth in the Rational...
Then fruits... come forth from the heavenly marriage, which is that of good and truth.
The laws of marriages... and also those of inheritance... had their origin from the celestial and spiritual marriage... or that of good and truth...
In the Natural, as in each and all things in man, nay, in universal nature, there must be the marriage of good and truth. Explained.
The union between the heart and lungs... they represented by the marriage of good and truth...
The cause in the Spiritual World was from the heavenly marriage of good and truth, in which the births are no other than truths of faith and goods of charity...
Therefore, there is no genuine conjugial love, unless they are in good and truth, thus together in the heavenly marriage.

The conjunction of truth with good and of good with truth is the Conjugial understood in the spiritual sense; that is, that which makes with a man and in the Church the heavenly marriage. The arcana of this heavenly marriage are described in these things... which are these. The heavenly marriage is that of good with truth and of truth with good, but not between good and truth of one and the same degree, but between the good and truth of a lower and a higher degree; that is, not between the good of the external man and the truth of the same, but between the good of the external man and the truth of the internal...

The case is the same in the spiritual man; between the good and truth there there is no heavenly marriage, but between the good of the spiritual man and the truth of the celestial man... Nor is there the heavenly marriage between the good and truth in the celestial man, but between the good of the celestial man and the truth Divine which proceeds from the Lord...
The scientifics which are truths, and the delights which are good, are conjoined, but they do not make with him the heavenly marriage. Explained.
Then this conjunction with the scientific and doctrinal things of the external man makes with him the heavenly marriage; this is impossible with the evil...
[Zebulon] in the internal sense, = the heavenly marriage; in the external, conjugial love. AC 4606:2.

The reason cohabitation, in the internal sense, = the heavenly marriage, is thence; for from the Divine marriage, which is the union of the Father and the Son... comes forth the heavenly marriage. The heavenly marriage is what is called the Lord's Kingdom, and also Heaven; and this because it comes forth from the Divine marriage, which is the Lord.
That the heavenly marriage is from the Divine good which is in the Lord, and from the Divine truth which is [from]. Him. References.

After this conjunction has been effected, then the interior and the exterior man can enter into the heavenly marriage... For it is the good of the interior man which then conjoins itself with the good of the exterior, and through this with the truth there; and also the good of the interior man through the affection of truth there with the good of the exterior man, and also with the truth there; thus immediately and mediately.

After the conjunction has been effected of the interior man with the external, or of the spiritual with the natural, there takes place the fructification of good and the multiplication of truth; for that conjunction is the heavenly marriage with man; and from this marriage these things are born.
Then both (the married partners) are together in the heavenly marriage, which is that of good and truth; thus in conjugial love...
From this (conjunction of good and truth) the Lord's Kingdom is called in the Word the heavenly marriage.
For all conjunction of good and truth has joy in it, because this is the heavenly marriage, in which is the Divine.

The Lord's Divine Human is the Divine marriage itself; the things which proceed thence... constitute the heavenly marriage, which is truth conjoined with good, and good conjoined with truth. This marriage is in Heaven, and in everyone who is in Heaven; and also in everyone who is in the Church, if he is in good and at the same time in truth.
Because by the tribe of Zebulon is signified the heavenly marriage, in which is Heaven...
Heaven is likened to a wedding from the heavenly marriage, which is the marriage of good and truth.
From the marriage of good and truth. Signified. AC 4647.

For marriage represented the marriage of good and truth, that is, the heavenly marriage; and therefore also the Church; for the Church is the Church from the marriage of good and truth; and when the Church is in this marriage it makes one with Heaven, which is the heavenly marriage itself...
Conjugial love derives its origin from the love of good and truth, which is of the heavenly marriage; and this marriage is Heaven itself or the Lord's Kingdom.
Therefore, in order that the heavenly marriage may be in a man, or he in the heavenly marriage, these two things (good and truth) must make one with him.
For the reciprocal conjunction of good and truth... is the heavenly marriage.
The heavenly marriage and its doctrinal things. Signified.
For in the Word, for the sake of the heavenly marriage, where it treats of the External it also treats of the Internal; and where of truth, there also of good.

The reason there is an image of marriage in all things, is that all things have relation to good and truth, thus to the heavenly marriage, which is that of good and truth; and the heavenly marriage to the Divine marriage, which is that of Divine good and Divine truth.
As the Sabbath represented these things, it also represented Heaven as to the conjunction of good and truth, which conjunction is called the heavenly marriage. AC 8886.
Therefore it was named the Jubilee, by which was represented the marriage of good and truth in the Inmost Heaven.
The combat which precedes and prepares for the heavenly marriage. Signified, Explained. AC 10366.
But when the man is in good, and through good is led by the Lord, he is then in the heavenly marriage, thus in Heaven; for the heavenly marriage is Heaven.
As by the Sabbath is signified the heavenly marriage, which is Heaven... AC 8889.

For the good with man is not spiritual good until it has been formed by truths; and when it has been formed, then there is the heavenly marriage; for this is the conjunction of good and truth, and is Heaven itself with man.
That there is then the heavenly marriage from the Lord. Signified.
The seventh day = a state of celestial love... thus the heavenly marriage; for the heavenly marriage is the conjunction of good and truth, which is Heaven in man.
For the marriage of good and truth is the Church itself, because it is Heaven in man. References.
For marriage on earth represents the heavenly marriage, which is of good and truth; moreover, conjugial love corresponds to this marriage. References.
The copulation of a concubine with a man does not correspond to the heavenly marriage...
The heart conjoins itself with the lungs, and the lungs in turn with the heart... Such also is the marriage of good with truth and of truth with good in Heaven.
The ultimate receptacle of the heavenly marriage, which is that of Divine good with Divine truth. Signified.
The marriage of truth with good. Signified. For the conjunction of truth and good is called the heavenly marriage. AC 9736.
The heavenly marriage is the marriage of good and truth, or the conjunction of the Lord and Heaven.

For conjugial love descends from the marriage of good and truth in the Heavens; and as the marriage of good and truth is in the Heavens, and makes the Heavens, therefore love truly conjugial is Heaven itself with man; for the marriage of good and truth in the Heavens descends from the conjunction of the Lord with the Heavens. Explained.
With a spiritual man and Angel the marriage of good and truth takes place in the intellectual part; but with a celestial man and Angel in the voluntary part.
Therefore, by the place at the door of the Tent was represented the conjunction of good and truth, which conjunction is called the heavenly marriage. AC 10022.
The conjunction of good and truth is what is called the heavenly marriage, which is Heaven itself with man...
The heavenly marriage is the conjunction of good and truth with a man of the Church and an Angel of Heaven; and, in the supreme sense, the union of the Divine Itself in the Lord's Human.

This, now, is what is called the conjunction of good and truth, or the heavenly marriage. Explained... This conjunction, or this marriage, is what is called the Church, and Heaven, and also the Lord's Kingdom; nay, in the supreme sense, the Lord with man.
The conjunction of good and truth. Signified, Explained.
From the conjunction of truth and good descending into the body comes forth conjugial love.
Hence the conjunction of truth and good is called the heavenly marriage; and the heavenly marriage is Heaven.
Internal peace, like internal innocence, does not exist except in wisdom; and as it exists in wisdom, it exists in the conjunction of good and truth; for thence is wisdom.
The conjunction of truth and good makes an Angel, and also his intelligence, wisdom, and happiness...

The reason the Divine which proceeds from the Lord inflows principally into conjugial love, is that conjugial love descends from the conjunction of good and truth; for... whether you say the conjunction of the understanding and the will, or the conjunction of good and truth, it is the same. The conjunction of good and truth derives its origin from the Divine love of the Lord towards all... Explained.
Hence it is that the conjunction of good and truth in the Heavens is called the heavenly marriage.
[Swedenborg footnote 1.]. How the conjunction of good and truth is effected, and with whom. References.
The delight of adultery is also the delight of destroying the conjunction of good and truth, which conjunction makes Heaven.
The state of Heaven with man is the conjunction of good and truth with him...
The conjunction of good and truth is called in Heaven the heavenly marriage; for all who are there are in this marriage.
That in each thing of the Word there is the marriage of the Lord and the Church, and thence the marriage of good and truth. General article.
This is the marriage of truth and good with man...
The conjunction of good and truth is called in what follows the heavenly marriage; and the conjunction of evil and falsity the infernal marriage.

The Angels thus represented the conjunction of the heart and the lungs, and at the same time their correspondence with the love of the will and the wisdom of the understanding: they called this correspondence and union the heavenly marriage...
In the created universe and in each thing of it there is the marriage of good and truth... DLW 409, Explained.
If both (the will and the understanding) are elevated, there is effected the marriage of them there, which is called the heavenly marriage, because it is that of heavenly love and wisdom. DLW 419:2.

Something shall now be said in special concerning this one, or union, which is called the marriage of good and truth. This marriage is, 1. In the Lord Himself; for... the Divine love and Divine wisdom are one in Him. 2. It is from the Lord; for in everything which proceeds from Him love and wisdom are completely united... (Five more propositions stated in order.)

These three things are to be premised: First. That in the universe and in each and all things of it which have been created by the Lord, there was the marriage of good and truth. Second. That this marriage was severed in man after the creation. Third. That it is of the Divine Providence that what has been severed should be made one, and thus that the marriage of good and truth should be restored.
There is the marriage of good and truth in the cause; and there is the marriage of good and truth from the cause in the effect. Explained.
The marriage of good and truth is from the marriage of the Lord with the Church; and this is from the marriage of love and wisdom in the Lord...
Such is the conjunction of the Lord with the Church, and of the Church with the Lord, which is called the celestial and spiritual marriage.
The image of the Infinite and the Eternal is nowhere in man except in the marriage of good and truth.
The initiaments of man in the marriage of good and truth, or the spiritual marriage, are like the flowers...
The conjunction of good and truth is called the heavenly marriage; from this is the Church with man, and is Heaven with him...

By the ultimate delights two married partners are more united in the marriage of good and truth; and the marriage of good and truth is the marriage of love and wisdom; and love and wisdom are the offspring which are born from that marriage.
There are weddings in the Heavens... for no others there than those who are in the marriage of good and truth, nor are others Angels...
The reason the sphere of conjugial love is the very sphere of Heaven, is that it descends from the heavenly marriage of the Lord and the Church.
That the origin of this love is the marriage of good and truth. Explained. CL 62, Explained.
(With the husband and wife) there is then effected the full conjunction of good and truth; and the conjunction of good and truth is the Church.

(Thus) two married partners are the very forms and effigies of the marriage of love and wisdom, or of good and truth... Thus it may be seen that two married partners who are in love truly conjugial are actually forms of the marriage of good and truth...
There is a correspondence between the spiritual marriage, which is that of truth with good, and natural marriage, which is that of a man with one wife.
On the origin of conjugial love from the marriage of good and truth. Chapter.
That from the influx of the marriage of good and truth from the Lord, is the love of the sex; and that there is conjugial love. Explained.
The reason such a sphere of the marriage of good and truth proceeds from the Lord, is that this sphere is also the sphere of propagation... CL 94.
That the male and the female were created to be the very form of the marriage of good and truth... Explained.

Thus inflows the marriage of good and truth from the Lord with man, immediately into his soul; and thence it advances to the things which follow, and through these to the extremes; and thus conjointly they make conjugial love.

In the middle of the paper there was written in golden letters, The Marriage of Good and Truth... As the Angel descended with the paper in his hand... the writing... was changed into a silver colour, then into a copper one, afterwards into an iron one, and finally into the colour of iron and copper rust: and at last the Angel was seen to enter a dark mist, and pass through the mist to the earth; and there the paper was not seen, although the Angel still held it in his hand...

All things in the universal Heaven, and all things in the universal world, are nothing else than a marriage of good and truth; because each and all things... were created from the marriage of good and truth, and into it. Explained.

The Angels said further, that the Holy Scripture... is in general and in part the marriage of good and truth; and as the Church... and religion... are, among Christians, solely from the Holy Scripture, it may be evident that the Church in general and in part is the marriage of good and truth...

After this the Angel spoke of the Marriage of Good and Truth with married partners; saying, that if their minds were in that marriage, the husband being truth, and the wife the good thereof, they would both be in the deliciousness of the blessedness of innocence... and the prolific of the husband would be in a continual spring... and the wife would be in a continual reception...

That from the marriage of good and truth which proceeds from the Lord and inflows, man receives truth, and with this the Lord conjoins good; and that thus the Church is formed by the Lord with man. Explained.
With them conjugial love... successively opens a way for itself to the spiritual marriage itself, which is that of good and truth, which is its origin...
That offspring born of two who are in love truly conjugial, derive from their parents the Conjugial of good and truth... Explained. CL 203. CL 204.
Nothing is received by males from the spiritual marriage, which is that of good and truth... except truth...
For the soul of every man derives life from the marriage of good and truth; and from this marriage is the Church.
There are three regions of the human mind... and in each region there is the marriage of good and truth...
By the spiritual marriage is meant the conjunction of the Lord and the Church; and thence also the marriage of good and truth; (both of which marriages) are in each and all things of the Word...
(The effects of the conjunction of good and truth with man, or of their separation. Described.)
This is called the heavenly marriage.
When the heavenly marriage is thought of...
The conjunction of good and truth is effected in the spiritual man, and thence in the natural man...
This conjunction into one is called the heavenly marriage; and from this marriage are Heaven and the Church...

The conjunction of the Lord with the man of the Church is the conjunction of good and truth; from the Lord is good, and with man is truth; thence the conjunction which is called the heavenly marriage; from this marriage comes forth love truly conjugial between two married partners who are in such conjunction with the Lord... AE 995:end.

Therefore, from the marriage of good and truth comes forth the love of fructifying; namely, of fructifying good through truth, and truth from good; from which love descends the love of prolificating...

The reason man grows young in Heaven is that he then enters into the marriage of good and truth; and in good there is the constant endeavour to love truth, and in truth there is the constant endeavour to love good; and then the wife is good in form, and the man is truth in form; and from this endeavour man puts off everything severe, sad, and dryly senile, and puts on what is lively, glad, and vigorously youthful...
On the marriage of the Lord with the Church, which is the marriage of good and truth in the Word. General article.
For from the marriage of good and truth there descend and are derived all loves... From this marriage are formed all the heavenly Societies...
